item.title: Women on the Move: Sindh Launches Free Scooties in Hyderabad and Sukkur
item.description: The Sindh government along with the Sindh Mass Transit Authority (SMTA), has launched a free scooty program in Hyderabad and Sukkur. This initiative aims to address transportation challenges for women, focusing on students and working women.
